purpose: Teach: 水路/電線/イスラーム/清浄/農法/明瞭/新約/精製

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、工場用水の水路、つまり水路を整備しろ
lines.en: Get our factory's water channels in order — the canals themselves. See to it.
lines.style: Low, controlled command, no raised volume. Clipped consonants, expecting to be heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。電線、つまり電線整備の工事を進めます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll move the power-line installation work forward — the wiring upgrade.
lines.style: Prompt, businesslike pickup. Efficient pace, a competent nod folded into the phrasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、イスラーム、つまりイスラーム圏向け商品を企画しろ
lines.en: Plan a product line for the Islamic market — for the whole Islamic world.
lines.style: Direct order, flat and unadorned. A beat of silence before it, doubling the weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の清浄、つまり清浄度を高めます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll raise the products' purity — push the cleanliness grade higher.
lines.style: Quick affirmative, then steadier detail. Slight tiredness under the professionalism, still sharp.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、有機農法、つまり農法ブランドで差別化しろ
lines.en: Differentiate us with an organic-farming brand — make the method itself the selling point.
lines.style: Strategic emphasis on differentiate, measured and dry. The vision delivered without flourish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告コピーを明瞭、つまり明瞭簡潔にします
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll make the ad copy clear — clear and concise.
lines.style: Crisp echo of the brief, faint wry undertone. Doubling the key word deliberately.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新約、つまり新約事業の開拓を進めろ
lines.en: Push ahead on the new-contract business — open that ground up.
lines.style: Final directive energy building quietly. Firmer landing, gaze-level authority, still no volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品の精製、つまり精製工程の品質を上げます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll raise the quality of the refining process — of every refinement step.
lines.style: Committed closing affirmation, slower and surer. The last words set down like a signature.
